title: penstemon grinnellii subsp. scrophularioides
intro: Penstemon grinnellii subsp. scrophularioides, commonly known as Grinnell's beardtongue, is a plant species in the family Plantaginaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Penstemon grinnellii subsp. scrophularioides include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe wounds, reduce fever, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antispasmodic, expectorant, and antitussive effects.
